ai.pathTitle: How a business trains its AI — in about 15 minutes

price.ask: How much is a 22k gold chain?
price.untrained: Prices vary depending on several factors. Please contact the store for more information.
price.trained: Today's 22k rate is on our website and making charges start at 8% 😊 A 10-gram chain is usually ₹68,000–₹75,000. Shall I send you our latest chain designs?
price.why: Uses the pricing from the business profile and offers the next step.

delivery.untrained: I'm not sure about delivery options. Please check the website.
delivery.trained: Yes! Free insured delivery anywhere in India in 3–5 working days. Would you like to place an order or visit our T. Nagar store?
delivery.why: Answered from a Q&A pair the team added.

refund.ask: Can I return a ring if it doesn't fit?
refund.trained: Of course — you can exchange it within 7 days, and we resize rings free of charge. Just keep the bill handy 🙏
refund.why: Follows the store policy written in the profile.

human.ask: I'm very unhappy, my order is late!
human.untrained: Sorry for the inconvenience. Please wait.
human.trained: I'm really sorry about this. I'm passing you to Priya from our team right now — she'll check your order and call you within 10 minutes.
human.why: Rule: complaints go to a human, with a promise of quick help.
